subject.title: [Performance] Uncached glob resolution in plugin manifest discovery during startup

question: Should plugin-discovery performance work be pursued as a measured extension of the existing metadata-snapshot cache rather than introducing a new lockfile-hash manifest cache?
rationale: The report identifies a plausible cost, but its proposed invalidation model has not been validated against current discovery semantics or locally changed and linked plugins.

options.title: Request a focused profile
options.body: Ask for a current-release timing trace and plugin layout that identifies the remaining repeated discovery call before scheduling implementation.

options.title: Adopt a new cache design
options.body: Approve a lockfile-hash cache only after an owner defines invalidation behavior for local, linked, and workspace plugin changes.

recommendation.title: Request a focused profile
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-release timing trace and plugin layout that identifies the remaining repeated discovery call before scheduling implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent released work covers plugin metadata snapshots and startup filesystem-scan reductions.
